title: US-Mediated Russia-Ukraine Talks Resume in Abu Dhabi After Nine Months
detail: On Nov 10 Russian, Ukrainian and US delegations opened trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi, the first since February. The US side included Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner; Vladimir Medinsky led Russia's delegation and Rustem Umerov Ukraine's. The roughly four-hour session focused on humanitarian issues (prisoner exchanges, civilians and children in captivity) and security guarantees, with a possible energy and maritime ceasefire also on the agenda. Zelenskyy called it 'constructive and quite substantive'; Rubio called it 'very productive' but said much work remained. No breakthrough was reported; Moscow still demands withdrawal from annexed regions and rejects a ceasefire along current lines. A second day was scheduled for Nov 11.

media.caption: Russia and Ukraine hold nearly 4 hours of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi
